description: This file defines the interface for IWebAudioPlayer and its factory in the Rialto project, including methods for controlling web audio playback, querying buffer status, and managing volume. It also declares external dependencies and the namespace.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IWebAudioPlayer instances, providing a static method to instantiate the factory and a method to create web audio players with specified parameters.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayer
classes.description: Interface for web audio player, providing methods to control playback, query buffer status, set volume, and retrieve client info.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a new IWebAudioPlayer instance with specified client, mime type, priority, and configuration.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback of the web audio.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Notifies the player that no more frames will be provided, triggering EOS state after buffered frames are played.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves the number of available frames for writing and optional shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves the number of frames left to be played.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes a buffer of audio frames for playback.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves preferred and maximum buffer sizes and support for deferred play.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the current volume level for the pipeline.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the client associated with the web audio player.
